mapper.sql: session_id, user_id, title, source, status, parent_session_id, compact_anchor_seq, last_run_id, message_count, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pi_session (session_id, user_id, title, source, status, parent_session_id, compact_anchor_seq, last_run_id, message_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{source}, #{status}, #{parentSessionId}, #{compactAnchorSeq}, #{lastRunId}, #{messageCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pi_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pi_session SET source = COALESCE(#{source}, source), compact_anchor_seq = #{compactAnchorSeq}, last_run_id = #{lastRunId}, message_count = #{messageCount}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pi_session ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM pi_session WHERE parent_session_id IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT FROM pi_session WHERE parent_session_id = #{parentSessionId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
